\caption{\bt{Accuracy (\%) of the user agent by data change, DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, five independent runs per method (\ScenCells\ runs, \ScenValidTasks\ scored tasks, \ScenAgentHours\ agent-hours). Bars pool the runs; lines are 95\% bootstrap intervals over runs; a hatched bar marks a setting in which at least 25\% of the tasks used a stale definition, i.e., one whose canonical SQL answers that setting's questions incorrectly. Shaded groups pool the settings of their class. The covered breaks target key uniqueness (status rows, restated sales, duplicate load), join cardinality (SCD Type 2), and date-key completeness (date-key format). The self-verification variant of example retrieval and the two \system\ regression variants are reported in the text.}{按数据变化划分的用户端智能体正确率（\%），DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，每种方法 5 次独立运行（共 \ScenCells\ 次运行、\ScenValidTasks\ 道计分题、\ScenAgentHours\ 智能体小时）。柱为 5 次运行合并的正确率，竖线为按运行重抽样的 95\% 区间；斜线表示该情形下至少 25\% 的题使用了过期定义，即其规范 SQL 在该情形下答错的定义。底色组把同类情形合并。条件覆盖的破坏分别针对键唯一性（状态变更行、多版本更正、重复加载）、连接基数（缓慢变化维）和日期键完整性（日期键格式）。示例检索的自行核验变体与 \system\ 的两个回归测试变体在正文中报告。}}
\label{fig:scenarios}
\Description{A grouped bar chart with ten groups of six bars and a legend across the top: no memory, example retrieval, invalidate on schema change, invalidate on every write, full recheck per definition, MAVRA (ours), and a hatched swatch for a stale definition in at least 25 percent of tasks. Groups, in three classes bracketed under the axis: held-out and the four benign updates pooled (no change, benign updates); status rows, restated sales, duplicate load, SCD Type 2, date-key format, and all covered breaks pooled (breaks covered by a condition); unit change and backup copy (outside the guarantee). Every sharing method reaches 98 to 100 percent on held-out questions and 93 to 99 on benign updates, no memory 58 and 49. Under status rows MAVRA, every write, and full recheck answer 100, example retrieval 64 and schema change 62 with the schema-change bar hatched; under restated sales MAVRA and full recheck 100, every write 89, schema change 85 hatched, example retrieval 83; under duplicate loads MAVRA 52, full recheck 48, schema change 40 hatched, example retrieval 35, every write 21; under SCD Type 2 all sharing methods 100, schema change hatched; under the date-key format all methods between 7 and 13. Over all covered breaks, with the values printed above the bars: no memory 32, example retrieval 59, schema change 60, every write 65, full recheck 71, MAVRA 72 with interval 70 to 73. Unit change 27 to 49 with hatched bars for every method that keeps definitions across writes; backup copy 46 to 74, schema change highest among the sharing methods and hatched, MAVRA 56.}
